# TechScience

> > TechScience Press publishes peer-reviewed open access journals spanning computational mechanics, materials science, biomedical engineering, and renewable materials research.

TechScience is a scholarly publisher offering multiple open access journals with archives of peer-reviewed research. The site provides access to journal issues, tables of contents, and submission portals for academic researchers across engineering, life sciences, and computational disciplines.

## Key Topics

- Open Access Journals
- Computational Mechanics
- Peer Review
- Biomechanics
- Materials Science
- Renewable Materials
- Quantum Computing
- Cancer Research
- Cell Biology
- Computational Engineering
- Academic Publishing
- Journal Issues
- Tech Science Press
- Manuscript Central

## Core Journal Homepages

- [CMC - Computers, Materials & Continua](https://www.techscience.com/journal/cmc): Open access journal covering computer networks, AI, and materials science research
- [CSSE - Computer Systems Science and Engineering](https://www.techscience.com/journal/csse): Open access journal dedicated to computer systems science and engineering

## Computational Mechanics & Engineering Archives

- [CMES-Vol. 43, No. 3, 2009](https://www.techscience.com/CMES/v43n3): CMES journal issue covering computational mechanics methods
- [CMES-Vol. 83, No. 4, 2012](https://www.techscience.com/CMES/v83n4): CMES journal issue on computational methods and mechanics
- [CMES-Vol. 93, No. 5, 2013](https://www.techscience.com/CMES/v93n5): CMES journal issue addressing computational mechanics topics
- [CMES-Vol. 99, No. 5, 2014](https://www.techscience.com/CMES/v99n5): CMES journal issue on computational mechanics applications
- [ICCES-Vol. 3, No. 3, 2007](https://www.techscience.com/icces/v3n3): ICCES journal issue covering computational engineering methods
- [ICCES-Vol. 14, No. 3, 2010](https://www.techscience.com/icces/v14n3): ICCES journal issue on computational engineering applications

## Biomedical & Life Sciences Archives

- [MCB-Vol. 12, No. 4, 2015](https://www.techscience.com/mcb/v12n4): MCB journal issue on biomechanics research and applications
- [MCB-Vol. 18, No. 4, 2021](https://www.techscience.com/mcb/v18n4): MCB journal issue addressing biomechanics studies
- [CHD-Vol. 14, No. 5, 2019](https://www.techscience.com/chd/v14n5): CHD journal issue on congenital heart disease research
- [Oncologie-Vol. 23, No. 4, 2021](https://www.techscience.com/oncologie/v23n4): Oncologie journal issue covering cancer research advances
- [BIOCELL-Vol. 30, Suppl. S, 2006](https://www.techscience.com/biocell/v30nSuppl.S): BIOCELL journal supplement on cell biology research
- [BIOCELL-Vol. 44, Suppl. 2, 2020](https://www.techscience.com/biocell/v44nSuppl.2): BIOCELL journal supplement addressing cellular biology topics

## Materials & Quantum Computing Archives

- [CMC-Vol. 57, No. 3, 2018](https://www.techscience.com/cmc/v57n3): CMC journal issue on computers, materials and continua
- [JRM-Vol. 6, No. 5, 2018](https://www.techscience.com/jrm/v6n5): JRM journal issue on renewable materials research
- [JRM-Vol. 10, No. 4, 2022](https://www.techscience.com/jrm/v10n4): JRM journal issue covering renewable materials science
- [JQC-Vol. 2, No. 4, 2020](https://www.techscience.com/jqc/v2n4): JQC journal issue on quantum computing research and theory

## Botany Archives

- [PHYTON-Vol. 75, 2006](https://www.techscience.com/phyton/v75nall): PHYTON journal Vol. 75 experimental botany archive
- [PHYTON-Vol. 77, 2008](https://www.techscience.com/phyton/v77nall): PHYTON journal Vol. 77 experimental botany archive
